package service

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	meshproto "github.com/apache/dubbo-admin/api/mesh/v1alpha1"
	adminmodel "github.com/apache/dubbo-admin/pkg/console/model"
	meshresource "github.com/apache/dubbo-admin/pkg/core/resource/apis/mesh/v1alpha1"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

const conditionFixtureLicense = `#
# Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one or more
# contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file distributed with
# this work for additional information regarding copyright ownership.
# The ASF licenses this file to You under the Apache License, Version 2.0
# (the "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance with
# the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#

`

// Run inside the pinned Admin source tree; setupRollbackTestEnv is Admin's own fixture.
func TestExportGoConditionCompatibilityFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("DUBBO_GO_CONDITION_FIXTURES")
	require.NotEmpty(t, dir)
	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755))
	write := func(name string, spec *meshproto.ConditionRoute) {
		b, err := meshresource.MarshalRuleSpec(spec)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".yaml"), append([]byte(conditionFixtureLicense), b...), 0644))
	}
	serviceRequest := adminmodel.BaseServiceReq{ServiceName: "org.apache.dubbo.condition.CompatService", Version: "1.0.0", Group: "compat"}
	require.Equal(t, "org.apache.dubbo.condition.CompatService:1.0.0:compat", serviceRequest.ServiceKey())
	service := &meshproto.ConditionRoute{ConfigVersion: "v3.0", Scope: "service", Key: serviceRequest.ServiceName, Force: true, Runtime: true, Enabled: true, Conditions: []string{"=>env=stable"}}
	write("service-initial", service)
	service.Conditions = []string{"=>host=127.0.0.2"}
	write("service-updated", service)
	service.Enabled = false
	write("service-disabled", service)
	service.Enabled = true
	service.Conditions = []string{"=>host=192.0.2.1"}
	write("service-empty", service)
	write("consumer-application-initial", &meshproto.ConditionRoute{ConfigVersion: "v3.0", Scope: "application", Key: "condition-compat-consumer", Force: true, Runtime: true, Enabled: true, Conditions: []string{"=>host=127.0.0.2"}})
	ctx := setupRollbackTestEnv(t)
	name := "condition-compat-provider.condition-router"
	res := meshresource.NewConditionRouteResourceWithAttributes(name, "")
	res.Spec = &meshproto.ConditionRoute{ConfigVersion: "v3.0", Scope: "application", Key: "condition-compat-provider", Force: true, Runtime: true, Enabled: true, Conditions: []string{"=>env=stable"}}
	require.NoError(t, CreateConditionRule(ctx, res))
	write("application-initial", res.Spec)
	require.NoError(t, UpdateInstanceTrafficStatus(ctx, "", "condition-compat-provider", "127.0.0.1", true))
	res, err := GetConditionRule(ctx, name, "")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	write("application-disable-a", res.Spec)
	require.NoError(t, UpdateInstanceTrafficStatus(ctx, "", "condition-compat-provider", "127.0.0.2", true))
	res, err = GetConditionRule(ctx, name, "")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	write("application-empty", res.Spec)
	require.NoError(t, UpdateInstanceTrafficStatus(ctx, "", "condition-compat-provider", "127.0.0.1", false))
	require.NoError(t, UpdateInstanceTrafficStatus(ctx, "", "condition-compat-provider", "127.0.0.2", false))
	res, err = GetConditionRule(ctx, name, "")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	write("application-restored", res.Spec)
	res.Spec.Enabled = false
	write("application-disabled", res.Spec)
}
